notes.title: Big Update #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32935031/19c9b97da6a4c20d7e6d64b2eb95052e4a6a60ff.png[/img]

Hello everyone!
We have just published the first big update. It brings quite a few exciting features as well as bug fixes and changes.  

[h1]NEW STUFF:[/h1]

ː5Starː [b]Controller Support[/b] - During the beta we promised we'll make it work. Here it is.  
ː5Starː [b]In-lobby leaderboard[/b] - Finally working
ː5Starː [b]Much smarter bots[/b] - Now they can properly play a CTF match from start to finish while looking like real players, as well as being much smarter overall in Classic too.
ː5Starː [b]New music[/b] - The old tracks got a little repetitive, eh?
ː5Starː [b]New building structures[/b] - To fill in the gaps in the blueprint, we've added a vertical pillar and a horizontal one. They turned out to be way more useful and fun to use than we thought.
ː5Starː [b]Stats [/b]- Yes, yes, yes! Now you can see detailed stats such as how many arrows you shot, your K/D ratio, won and lost matches and many more.
ː5Starː [b]New achievements[/b] - More than doubled the number of achievements that were previously present. 
ː5Starː [b]New chat emotes[/b] - Coupled with achievements!
ː5Starː [b]Building keybinds[/b] - By pressing from 1 to 6, you have direct access to the specific building structure on that position in the blueprint.
ː5Starː [b]Leveling system[/b] - Because it's soo satisfying to level up and gather XP!

[h1]BUG FIXES:[/h1]

ːCheckZː [b]Lobby & match crashes[/b]
ːCheckZː [b]Achievements not being granted / some not working[/b] - A little oopsie was the cause of those not working, but they're all now working.
ːCheckZː [b]Chat-game freeze bug[/b]: We were finally able to reproduce it and it's now fixed.
ːCheckZː [b]Server crashes[/b] - Apparently they [i]were [/i] a thing.
ːCheckZː [b]Some UI elements looking weird in Russian[/b]
ːCheckZː [b]Lots of other minor bug fixes[/b]

[h1]CHANGES:[/h1]

ːcozyjunimogreenː [b]Arrows fly faster now[/b] - Many people said they feel like the arrows fly a little too slowly, so we bumped their speed up a notch.

This is it for this update. (1.0.1.5) Have fun! ːslimehappyː
